hook.name: new:syndicate_death_warning
hook.quote: Silas, drop the badge. Syndicate leader Vance ordered everyone who saw this code silenced.

cliffhanger.name: new:imminent_confrontation_threat
cliffhanger.quote: Tell Vance I am coming for his server farm next.
cliffhanger.withheld_payoff: Whether Silas reaches Vance's server farm and what happens when he confronts him.

why_it_works: The warning makes Silas's danger clear immediately, then his answer promises a confrontation viewers have not seen.
risks: The viewer does not know what the code is or why Silas has a badge.
The threat is verbal; the screenplay does not establish a visual action or immediate attack.
The final line completes the promise rather than cutting mid-action, so the cliffhanger relies on anticipation of a future confrontation.

hook.name: new:imminent_threat_trap
hook.quote: You walked right into the kill zone, Detective.

cliffhanger.name: new:citywide_disaster_reveal
cliffhanger.quote: The virus is already pulsing through the city grid. You are ten seconds too late.
cliffhanger.withheld_payoff: Whether Silas can stop the virus from taking down the city grid.

why_it_works: It opens on a direct threat and ends with a citywide catastrophe already in motion, leaving Silas’s next move unresolved.
risks: The screenplay provides dialogue only, so any visual threat or reaction cannot be verified.
The specific danger of the kill zone and the virus may need visual context to land fully.
The cliffhanger says Silas is too late, which could weaken curiosity if delivered as a definitive resolution rather than a taunt.
